channel.title: GeoPulse. Geopolitics in brief
channel.description: Signal-first briefings on geopolitics, edited by Lavkesh Dwivedi.

item.title: Uncertainty Over Strait Escalates as U.S. and Iran Trade Threats
item.description: The US and Iran traded threats over the Strait of Hormuz. Uncertainty Over Strait Escalates as U. S. and Iran Trade Threats.

item.title: UAE says Iran has resumed attacks as the US moves to reopen the Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Iran resumed attacks as the US moved to reopen the Strait of Hormuz. UAE says Iran has resumed attacks as the US moves to reopen the Strait of Hormuz AP News.

item.title: UAE Defence Ministry says four cruise missiles fired from Iran
item.description: Four cruise missiles were fired from Iran at the UAE. Authorities ​in the ‌United Arab Emirates’ Fujairah ​said ⁠on May 4, that a ‌fire broke out ‌at ‌the Fujairah ⁠Oil ⁠Industry Zone following what they ​described ‌as a drone attack originating from ‌Iran.

item.title: The UAE says Iran resumes attacks as the U.S. moves to reopen the Strait of Hormuz
item.description: The US helped two merchant ships transit the Strait of Hormuz. The U. S. military said it helped two merchant ships transit the Strait of Hormuz, and the United Arab Emirates said it was fending off Iranian missiles and drones.

item.title: Three dead in suspected virus outbreak on Atlantic cruise ship
item.description: A suspected virus outbreak on an Atlantic cruise ship has resulted in three deaths. The World Health Organization confirmed one case of hantavirus infection and is investigating five more suspected cases.

item.title: Lebanon Latest
item.description: Israel intensified airstrikes in Lebanon. Israel intensifies airstrikes. Lebanon Latest.

item.title: US releases Touska container ship crew: Why it matters
item.description: The US released the crew members of the Touska container ship. Pakistan views this as a 'confidence-building measure' between Tehran and Washington, indicating a potential easing of tensions between the two nations.

item.title: Nigerian refinery accused of sacking union members is key to UK plan to tackle jet fuel shortage
item.description: A Nigerian refinery, accused of sacking union members, is crucial to the UK's plan to address a jet fuel shortage. The UK government hopes to import more fuel from the US and West Africa to mitigate the crisis.

item.title: US official says China is ‘funding’ Iran, urges Beijing to help open Hormuz
item.description: A US official stated that China is funding Iran and urged Beijing to help reopen the Strait of Hormuz through diplomacy. The US claims to have 'absolute control' of the strait, but seeks China's assistance.

item.title: UAE reports missile and drone strikes incoming from Iran
item.description: The UAE reported incoming missile and drone strikes from Iran, with no immediate reports of casualties. Iran has not commented on the incident, which raises concerns about the escalating tensions in the region.

item.title: UAE says it's under attack from Iranian missiles and drones despite ceasefire
item.description: The UAE stated it was under attack from Iranian missiles and drones, despite a ceasefire. The incident highlights the ongoing security challenges in the region, with the UAE facing continued threats from Iranian actions.

item.title: Iran Fires 'Warning Shots' At US Warships In Strait Of Hormuz
item.description: Iranian forces fired warning shots at US warships in the Strait of Hormuz, according to reports. The incident occurred amid heightened tensions between the two nations. The Fars news agency had earlier reported that Iran hit a US warship with missiles.

item.title: Satellite imagery reveals how Sudan’s war scorched its ‘breadbasket’
item.description: Satellite imagery reveals widespread destruction in Sudan's agricultural heartland, which was once the country's breadbasket. The war has triggered a severe hunger crisis in the region. Data from satellites shows how Sudan's war devastated its farming heartland, triggering a unprecedented hunger crisis.

item.title: Fire, explosion hit South Korean-run vessel in Strait of Hormuz, Seoul says
item.description: A South Korean-run vessel caught fire and exploded in the Strait of Hormuz, authorities in Seoul reported. No casualties were reported in the incident, which is currently under investigation. There were no casualties reported and authorities were investigating what caused the blaze.

item.title: Atmosphere detected on celestial body in solar system's far reaches
item.description: Astronomers detected an atmosphere on a celestial body in the outer reaches of the solar system. The discovery was made using advanced satellite data. Atmosphere detected on celestial body in solar system's far reaches.

item.title: Dollar edges up as US-Iran conflict keeps risk appetite in check
item.description: The US dollar edged up as investors remained cautious due to ongoing tensions between the US and Iran. The conflict has kept risk appetite in check, affecting global markets. Dollar edges up as US-Iran conflict keeps risk appetite in check.

item.title: Does Trump hold ‘all the cards’ against Iran in the Strait of Hormuz?
item.description: US President Trump expressed confidence in the standoff with Iran in the Strait of Hormuz. Tensions rose in the region with Trump suggesting he holds the upper hand. Trump signals confidence in Iran standoff as tensions rise in the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: South Korean Ship Targeted Amid Tensions In Hormuz
item.description: A South Korean ship was targeted in the Strait of Hormuz. The 24 crew members on board reported no casualties. There had been "no casualties to date" among the 24 crew members on board (file image).

item.title: Collin Morikawa withdraws from Truist Championship
item.description: Collin Morikawa withdrew from the Truist Championship. No reason was given for his withdrawal. Collin Morikawa withdraws from Truist Championship.

item.description: NATO's top leader said allies are preparing for a possible support role in the Strait of Hormuz. The development comes amid rising tensions in the region. The Weekly Preflight: 5 Things I'm Watching in Global Security | Week of May 4, 2026 Eyes Only with Wes O'Donnell.
